#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and self-validate the requested calendar entry.

Event: Project Kickoff Meeting
When:  next Monday, 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM (system local time)
Output: RFC 5545 iCalendar text printed to stdout.
"""
import datetime as dt
import sys
import uuid

MAX_LINE = 75  # RFC 5545 content-line octet limit


def next_monday(today: dt.date) -> dt.date:
    """The first Monday strictly after *today*."""
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + dt.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fold(line: str) -> str:
    """Fold a content line to <= 75 octets using CRLF + space (ASCII input)."""
    if len(line) <= MAX_LINE:
        return line
    parts = []
    remaining = line
    first = True
    while remaining:
        limit = MAX_LINE if first else MAX_LINE - 1
        parts.append(remaining[:limit])
        remaining = remaining[limit:]
        first = False
    return "\r\n ".join(parts)


def utc_fmt(value: dt.datetime) -> str:
    value = value.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    return value.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def main() -> int:
    now_local = dt.datetime.now().astimezone()
    monday = next_monday(now_local.date())
    tz_name = now_local.tzinfo.tzname(now_local) if now_local.tzinfo else "UTC"

    start_local = dt.datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0,
                              tzinfo=now_local.tzinfo)
    end_local = start_local + dt.timedelta(hours=2)
    stamp_utc = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)

    # Validation of derived event semantics
    assert monday > now_local.date(), "event must be in the future"
    assert start_local.weekday() == 0, "event must start on a Monday"
    assert start_local.hour == 10 and start_local.minute == 0
    assert end_local.hour == 12 and end_local.minute == 0
    assert end_local > start_local, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"

    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff.local"
    description = (
        "Project kickoff meeting. "
        f"Scheduled next Monday from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM local time ({tz_name})."
    )

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Local Calendar Assistant//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{utc_fmt(stamp_utc)}",
        f"DTSTART:{utc_fmt(start_local)}",
        f"DTEND:{utc_fmt(end_local)}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{description}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    ics_text = "\r\n".join(fold(line) for line in lines) + "\r\n"

    # Structural self-validation
    required = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT", "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting", "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    for field in required:
        assert field in ics_text, f"missing required element: {field}"
    assert ics_text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1
    assert ics_text.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
    assert len(ics_text.split("END:VCALENDAR", 1)[0]) > 0

    sys.stdout.write(ics_text)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
